```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)  # for color functions
library(RColorBrewer)
```

## Read in metabolite data
We'll be making two subplots here: one version with abx only information, and 
the other with all the comparisons from published literature. The 3 month group 
data will still be shown so it's easier to compare directionality. 

```{r read.data}
metab_betas = read.csv("data/metabolite_abx_regressions_betas.csv")
q_values = read.csv("data/metabolite_abx_regressions_qs.csv")

rownames(metab_betas) = metab_betas$plot_name
metab_betas$plot_name <- NULL

rownames(q_values) = q_values$plot_name
q_values$plot_name <- NULL

metabs_sorted <- metab_betas[order(metab_betas[, "abx_three"], decreasing = TRUE), ]
```

```{r rename.cols}
rename_vec <-  c(
    abx_three = "0 - 3 mo.",
    abx_twelve = "3 - 12 mo.",
    sol_beta_three   = "0 - 3 mo. (s)",
    sol_beta_six  = "3 - 6 mo.",
    beta_binary = "Any abx/5y.",
    beta_total = "Total/5 y."
  )

colnames(metabs_sorted) <- recode(colnames(metabs_sorted),
                                         !!!rename_vec)
```

## Create abx subplot

```{r p.val.fxn}
# Significance annotation logic
stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  if (p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p < 0.05)  return("*")
  if (p < 0.1)  return("#")
  return("")
}
```

### Create annotations
```{r}
sub_pathway <- metabs_sorted$SUB_PATHWAY

# Unique categories
unique_categories <- unique(sub_pathway)

# Assign colors from Paired palette (up to 12 colors)
palette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(13)
category_colors <- setNames(palette[1:length(unique_categories)], unique_categories)

gene_microbe_colors <- c(
  'Genetics' = 'black',
  'Microbiome' = '#dbb17c',
  'Hybrid' = '#7a5321',
  'N/A' = '#FAEBD7')

row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  SUB_PATHWAY = sub_pathway,
  Determinant_Association = metabs_sorted$Determinant_Association,
  col = list(
    SUB_PATHWAY = category_colors,
    Determinant_Association = gene_microbe_colors),
  simple_anno_size = unit(3, "mm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  gp = gpar(col = "#696969", lwd = 0.15)
)
```


### Plot
```{r subset.cols}
cols <- c("0 - 3 mo.", "3 - 12 mo.", "0 - 3 mo. (s)", "3 - 6 mo.", "Any abx/5y.", "Total/5 y.")
q_cols <- c("abx_three", "abx_twelve", "sol_q_three", "sol_q_six", "q_binary", "q_total")

abx_matrix <- as.matrix(metabs_sorted[, cols])
rownames(abx_matrix) <- rownames(metabs_sorted)

q_matrix <- as.matrix(q_values[, q_cols])
qval_mat <- q_matrix[rownames(abx_matrix), ]
```


```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
abx_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-0.5, 0, 0.5), c("blue", "white", "red")) #"#FFF0F5"
col_split = c("Arivale", "Arivale", "HCHS/SOL", "HCHS/SOL", "MetaCardis", "MetaCardis")


abx_ht <- Heatmap(abx_matrix,
                  name = "Beta coefficient",
                  col = abx_col_fun,
                  na_col = "#C0C0C0",
                  left_annotation = row_anno,
                  column_split = col_split,
                  column_names_rot = 45,
                  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                  cluster_rows = FALSE,
                  cluster_columns = FALSE,
                  show_row_names = TRUE, 
                  row_names_side = "left", 
                  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  height = unit(nrow(abx_matrix) * 5, "mm"),
                  rect_gp = gpar(col ="#696969", lwd = 1), 
                  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                     pval <- qval_mat[i, j]
                     star <- stars(pval)
                     grid.text(star, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black"))}
                   )
abx_ht
```

Save subplot A below!

```{r}
pdf("figures/metabs_abx_arivale_sol_metacardis.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)  # open a PDF device
plot(abx_ht)                                
dev.off()                                 
```

## Now make subplot for literature comparison
Here we also will introduce which metabolites are used for mediation analysis. 
That said, we will constrain the rows to only include metabolites which are 
associated with glucose control in other cohorts. 

```{r subset cols lit}
lit_estimates = read.csv("data/metabolite_meta_analysis_30Apr2026.csv")

rownames(lit_estimates) = lit_estimates$plot_name
lit_estimates$plot_name <- NULL

metabs_sorted_lit <- lit_estimates[order(
  lit_estimates[, "abx_three"], decreasing = TRUE), ]

rename_vec <-  c(
    abx_three = "0 - 3 mo.",
    chol_meds = "Cholesterol med. use",
    blood_sugar_meds = "Blood sugar med. use",
    MMC  = "MMC",
    UMMC = "UMMC", 
    IFG_OR  = "IFG",
    IGT_OR   = "IGT",
    CGI_T2D_OR = "CGI/T2D",
    EPIC_T2DM = "T2D (HR)",
    EPIC_two_dx_OR = "Multimorbidity (OR)",
    li_t2dm = "Incident T2D"
  )

colnames(lit_estimates) <- recode(colnames(lit_estimates), !!!rename_vec)
```

```{r subset rows}
metabs_keep = c(
  # Sorted by agreement
  # Agree: Positive
  "isoursodeoxycholate", # There was another one here
  
  # Agree: Negative
  "hippurate","cinnamoylglycine", "3-phenylpropionate", "indolepropionate",
  "X - 12216",
  
  # Disagree: Positive
  # "4-hydroxyhippurate",
  
  # Disagree: Negative
  "4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate",  "2-hydroxy-3-methylvalerate", "alpha-hydroxyisovalerate",
   "citrate", "N-lactoyl leucine", "alpha-hydroxyisocaproate", "3-hydroxydecanoate"
  
   #, "3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)lactate", "3-hydroxy-2-ethylpropionate", 
   #"X - 21353", "hydantoin-5-propionate", "acetylcarnitine (C2)"
)

lit_df_subset <- lit_estimates[metabs_keep, ]
```

### Add annotatons

```{r}
sub_pathway <- lit_df_subset$SUB_PATHWAY

row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  SUB_PATHWAY = sub_pathway,
  Determinant_Association = lit_df_subset$Determinant_Association,
  col = list(
    SUB_PATHWAY = category_colors,
    Determinant_Association = gene_microbe_colors),
  simple_anno_size = unit(3, "mm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  gp = gpar(col = "#696969", lwd = 0.15)
)
```

### Set up for heatmap

```{r, define.color.columns}
beta_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1.5, 0, 1.5), c("blue", "white", "red")) #"#FFF0F5"
or_col_fun   <- colorRamp2(c(0.5, 1, 2), c("#008080", "white", "#800000")) #FFFACD
hr_col_fun   <- colorRamp2(c(0.75, 1, 1.5), c("#191970", "white", "#FF1493")) #E6E6FA

# Now don't have Risk Ratio so can remove one color scheme
# hr_col_fun   <- colorRamp2(c(0.75, 1, 1.1), c("#006400", "white", "#F4A460"))
# cliff_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-0.75, 0, 0.75), c("pink", "white", "#4B0082")) #"#FFF0F5"

beta_cols <- c("0 - 3 mo.",
               "Cholesterol med. use",
               "Blood sugar med. use",
               "MMC", "UMMC"
               )

or_cols   <- c("IFG",
               "IGT",
               "CGI/T2D",
               "Multimorbidity (OR)")

hr_cols   <- c("Incident T2D", "T2D (HR)")

beta_matrix <- as.matrix(lit_df_subset[, beta_cols])
rownames(beta_matrix) <- rownames(lit_df_subset)
or_matrix   <- as.matrix(lit_df_subset[, or_cols])
hr_matrix   <- as.matrix(lit_df_subset[, hr_cols, drop = FALSE])

### Old
#cliff_matrix   <- as.matrix(lit_df_subset[, cliff_cols])
#rr_matrix   <- as.matrix(lit_df_subset[, rr_cols, drop = FALSE])

# Define gaps (e.g., split by study)
beta_split = c("Arivale", "Arivale","Arivale", "MetaCardis", "MetaCardis")
or_split = c("Swedish", "Swedish", "Swedish", "EPIC-Norfolk")
hr_split = c("HCHS/SOL", "EPIC-Norfolk")

## OLD
# cliff_split = c("MetaCardis", "MetaCardis")
# rr_split = c("HCHS/SOL")
```

Time to put the plots together!

```{r heatmap.plot}
# Plot heatmap with split and color legend
ht_beta <- Heatmap(beta_matrix,
                   name = "Beta coefficient",
                   col = beta_col_fun,
                   na_col = "#C0C0C0",
                   left_annotation = row_anno,
                   column_split = beta_split,
                   column_names_rot = 45,
                   column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                   column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                   cluster_rows = FALSE,
                   cluster_columns = FALSE,
                   show_row_names = TRUE, 
                   row_names_side = "left", 
                   row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                   height = unit(nrow(beta_matrix) * 5, "mm"),
                   rect_gp = gpar(col = "#696969", lwd = 1))

ht_or <- Heatmap(or_matrix,
                 name = "Odds Ratio",
                 col = or_col_fun,
                 na_col = "#C0C0C0",
                 column_split = or_split,
                 column_names_rot = 45,
                 column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                 column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                 cluster_rows = FALSE,
                 cluster_columns = FALSE,
                 show_row_names = FALSE, 
                 height = unit(nrow(or_matrix) * 5, "mm"),
                 rect_gp = gpar(col = "#696969", lwd = 1))

ht_hr <- Heatmap(hr_matrix,
                 name = "Hazard Ratio",
                 col = hr_col_fun,
                 na_col = "#C0C0C0",
                 column_split = hr_split,
                 column_names_rot = 45,
                 column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                 column_gap = unit(0, "mm"),
                 cluster_rows = FALSE,
                 cluster_columns = FALSE,
                 show_row_names = FALSE,
                 height = unit(nrow(hr_matrix) * 5, "mm"),
                 rect_gp = gpar(col = "#696969", lwd = 1))

# Combine
# all_plot <- ht_beta + hr_cliff + ht_hr + ht_or  + ht_rr
all_plot <- ht_beta + ht_or + ht_hr
```

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=11}
all_plot
```


```{r}
pdf("figures/metabs_lit_comparison_heatmap_metacardis_regs_li2026.pdf",
    width = 11, height = 7)  # open a PDF device
plot(all_plot)                                
dev.off()                                 
```
